blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. Image stylization with latent-diffusion models entangles two independently refined axes: what a region depicts and how it is depicted.
Such pipelines expose only global controls, yet professional retouching demands deliberate, region-specific control.
We lift two conditioning weights already present in a ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization pipeline from global scalars to per-location spatial maps, yielding local, per-axis control of content and style in a single generative pass.
Because the two weights act on disjoint pathways, adjusting them independently spans a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 retouching vocabulary, from free regeneration to identity preservation.
We validate that edits stay confined to the retouched region and that each weight predominantly steers its own axis.
Our approach requires no retraining and drops unchanged into any such pipeline.
blocks.zh:
。 。 。 。 以潜在扩散模型进行图像分层化会缠绕两个独立的精细轴:一个区域描绘什么,如何描绘.
这种管道只暴露出全球控制,而专业的调整要求则是针对特定区域的蓄意控制。
我们提升了ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization管道中已经存在的两个调制权重,从全球分层到每个位置的空间图,以单一基因传入的方式产生对内容和风格的局部,每轴控制.
由于两个重力作用于脱节路径,因此独立地调整它们跨出一个2×2×2×2×2}2重排词汇,从自由再生到身份保存.
我们验证的是,编辑仍限于被调整的区域,而且每个重量主要支配自己的轴心。
我们的做法不需要再培训,也不改变任何这种管道。

blocks.en:
Image stylization is the process of transforming an image to mimic a specific artistic medium or art style.
At its core it negotiates the tension between preserving an image’s underlying structure and re-rendering its appearance as artistic marks such as brush strokes ( Kyprianidis et al., 2013 ) .
Latent-diffusion models (LDMs) redefined this workflow by moving generation into a compact, perceptually compressed latent space, bringing unprecedented visual quality within reach of consumer hardware ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) .
However, whereas algorithmic filters transform an image locally, LDMs resynthesize it globally, so neither structure nor appearance stays pinned to the input pixels, turning stylization into a dual-axis process that manipulates what a region depicts (content) and how it is rendered (style) across the whole image.
Yet professional workflows such as graphic design demand local, spatial control: they realize deliberate design choices region by region, not as one uniform look.
Ideally, both axes should thus be controllable locally.
blocks.zh:
图像分层化(英語:Image stylization)是将一幅图像转化为模仿特定艺术媒介或艺术风格的过程.
Kyprianidis等人, 2013年。 校对:Soup
Lententnt-difusion models (LDMs) 重新定义了这个工作流程,将一代迁入一个紧凑的,能感知到被压缩的潜在空间,使消费者硬件能够达到前所未有的视觉质量(Rombach等,2022年).
然而,虽然算法过滤器会将一个图像转换为局部,但LDMs在全球范围进行再合成,因此结构或外观都无法被固定在输入像素上,将分层化变成一双轴过程,操纵一个区域描绘的内容(内容)以及如何在整个图像中渲染(风格).
然而,像平面设计这样的专业工作流程需要本地的空间控制:它们实现按区域,而不是单一的外观,精心设计选择。
理想的情况是,这两个轴应该可以在当地控制。

blocks.en:
Parameter-space painting brought exactly this spatial control to heuristic-based stylization, letting the user control where and how strongly an effect applies ( DeCarlo and Santella, 2002 ; Semmo et al., 2016 ) .
Conditioning and adapter methods that followed, e.g., ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) and IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) , restored some structural and stylistic control.
Yet a ControlNet conditioning image only specifies what structure to follow per location, while how strongly it is enforced and how strongly the image-prompt style is applied remain uniform over the image.
blocks.zh:
参数-空间绘画将这种空间控制完全带给基于血压的分层化,让用户控制效果在何地和如何强烈适用(DeCarlo and Santella, 2002;Semmo等人,2016年)。
所遵循的附加条件和适配方法,如ControlNet(张等,2023年)和IP-Adapter(叶等,2023年),恢复了部分结构与结构控制.
然而,ControlNet controling 映像只指定每个位置所遵循的结构,而其执行力度和图像即时样式的应用力度仍然一致。

blocks.en:
In this work, we bring the local control of parameter-space painting to the generative setting, spanning content as well as style.
We observe that the necessary controls already exist in a standard ControlNet + IP-Adapter pipeline as two scalar conditioning weights: a ControlNet strength governs adherence to content structure, and a per-block IP-Adapter scale governs adherence to the image-prompt style.
Our contribution is to lift each to a per-location spatial map and to validate quantitatively that the two controls, acting on disjoint pathways, stay local and axis-specific despite global attention mixing.
Together they span a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 vocabulary of retouching operations, from free regeneration to identity preservation (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们把对参数-空间绘画的局部控制带到了基因设定,既包括内容,也包括风格.
我们注意到,在标准的ControlNet + IP-Adapter 管道中已经存在必要的控制,作为两个分级调节权重:一个ControlNet强度制约对内容结构的遵守,一个每块IP-Adapter比例尺制约对图像快取风格的遵守.
我们的贡献是,将每个控制点提升到每个地点的空间地图,并从数量上证实,尽管全球关注点相互混合,但这两个控制点在互不关联的路径上仍保持局部和轴向特定。
它们共同跨越一个2×2 2×2×2}}2个重修操作词汇,从自由再生到身份保存(图1).

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Paint-with-words ( Balaji et al., 2022 ) and MultiDiffusion ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) steer the text pathway spatially, orthogonal to the content and style pathways we control.
A broad literature on layout, grounding, and region conditioning (surveyed in ( Cao et al., 2026 ) ) expands structural control but spatializes what is conditioned, not how strongly a pathway applies per location.
Spatially varying the IP-Adapter scale is an established practitioner technique, but for style alone.
SmartControl ( Liu et al., 2024 ) spatializes the ControlNet scale with a learned predictor that only relaxes a single structural condition where it conflicts with the prompt.
None couples a spatial content strength with a spatial style scale, which is our contribution rather than the regional idea itself.
blocks.zh:
用字画画 (Balaji等,2022年)和多向分散(Bar-Tal等,2023年)在空间上引导文本路径,正统地引导到我们控制的内容和风格路径.
关于布局、地平面和区域条件的广义文献(调查于(Cao等人,2026年))扩展了结构控制,但将条件化,而不是将路径适用于每个地点的程度。
空间变化的IP-Adapter尺度是一种既定的从业技术,但仅用于风格。
智能控制 (Liu等,2024年) 空间化 ControlNet 比例尺使用一个有学问的预测器,这个预测器只会在它与快取相冲突时放松单一的结构条件.
没有一个空间内涵的强度与空间风格的大小相配,这是我们的贡献,而不是区域思想本身。

blocks.en:
Adapter-based stylization conditions the generation on a style image rather than text: IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) injects image-prompt features through decoupled cross-attention, and InstantStyle ( Wang et al., 2024a ) shows that restricting this injection to specific attention blocks already separates style from content. B-LoRA ( Frenkel et al., 2024 ) independently confirms that these SDXL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) blocks specialize in style versus content.
Our pipeline builds on this image-prompt configuration, and preserves content through a ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) Tile branch in the manner introduced for stylization by InstantStyle-Plus ( Wang et al., 2024b ) .
A broader line separates the two factors more explicitly but globally , fixed for the whole forward pass ( Qi et al., 2024 ; Xing et al., 2024 ; Hertz et al., 2024 ; Jiang and Chen, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
基于适配器的分型化以样式图像而非文字为生成条件: IP-Adapter(Ye等,2023年)通过分解交叉意向来注入图像即时特性,而InstantStyle(Wang等,2024年a)显示,将这种注入限制在特定的注意块上,已经将风格与内容相分离. B-LORA(Frenkel等,2024年)独立地证实这些SDXL(Podel等,2024年)区块专门研究风格与内容.
我们的管道基于这种图像即时配置,并通过控制网保存内容(Zhang等,2023年) 由InstantStyle-Plus引入的分层分层活化方式(Wang等,2024b. 。 。 。 。
更宽泛的一行将两个因素更明确地区分开来,但在全球范围,固定在整个前行(Qi等,2024;Xing等,2024;Hertz等,2024;Jiang和Chen,2025)。

blocks.en:
Pretrained diffusion models also support stroke-, mask-, and instruction-guided editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2023 ; Avrahami et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) , but these target content (e.g., layout, attributes) and expose no per-location control of image- style strength.
In contrast, our spatial maps let both content and style strength be controlled per location.
blocks.zh:
预受训练的传播模型也支持中风,口罩,并指导性编辑(Meng等,2022;Hertz等,2023;Avrahami等,2023;Huang等,2025等),但这些目标内容(如布局,属性等),并暴露出不逐地控制图像风格强度.
相比之下,我们的空间地图可以控制每个位置的内容和风格强度。

blocks.en:
Non-photorealistic rendering has long varied an image’s level of abstraction locally, driven by gaze, saliency, or depth ( Kyprianidis et al., 2013 ; DeCarlo and Santella, 2002 ) or by parameter maps ( Semmo et al., 2016 ) .
The neural era continued this with perceptual-factor control ( Gatys et al., 2017 ) and depth- or saliency-guided style transfer ( Jing et al., 2020 ) .
Our maps are the generative counterpart of this abstraction control: they trade content preservation against style transfer per region.
blocks.zh:
非相片现实主义渲染长期以来在局部上对一幅图像的抽象程度有所变化,由凝视,显要,或深度所驱动(Kyprianidis等,2013;DeCarlo和Santella, 2002)或由参数地图所驱动(Semmo等,2016.
神经时代以知觉因子控制(Gattys等,2017年)和深度或显性导引式风格传入(Jing等,2020年)来延续了这一点.
我们的地图是这种抽象控制的基因对应:它们交易内容保护与每个区域的风格转移。

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Pipeline and Modulation Points
blocks.zh: 3.1. 管道和模块点

blocks.en:
Our method spatializes the two scalar conditioning weights of a standard latent-diffusion text-to-image pipeline ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) (Fig. 2 ), whose denoising U-Net is conditioned on content structure by a ControlNet branch ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) and on image-prompt style by an IP-Adapter path ( Ye et al., 2023 ) .
Driving the ControlNet with a Tile control turns this pipeline into an image stylizer ( Wang et al., 2024b ) .
The formulation depends only on these two pathways, not on a particular backbone, sampler, or distillation.
Sec. 4 describes our SDXL-based ( Podell et al., 2024 ) instantiation.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法将标准潜在分解文本到图像管道的两个分解分量权重(Rombach等,2022年)(图2)进行空间化,将U-Net去名化以ControlNet分支(Zhang等,2023年)的内容结构为条件,并用IP-Adapter路径(Ye等,2023年)为图像即时样式为条件。
(Wang等人,2024年b) 。 。 。 。
配方只依赖于这两种途径,而不是特定的骨干,采样器,或蒸馏.
第4条描述了我们基于SDXL(Podel等,2024年)的即时反应。

blocks.en: 3.3. Style Axis: Spatial IP-Adapter
blocks.zh: 3.3. 样式轴:空间IP-Adapter

blocks.en:
Each IP-Adapter–injected block adds a decoupled image-attention term to the text attention ( Ye et al., 2023 ) : (2) Z new = Attn ⁡ ( Q , K , V ) + λ b ​ Attn ​ ( Q , K ′ , V ′ ) , Z^{\mathrm{new}}=\mathrm{Attn}(Q,K,V)+\lambda_{b}\,\mathrm{Attn}(Q,K^{\prime},V^{\prime}), where the shared query Q Q comes from the block’s features, ( K , V ) (K,V) and ( K ′ , V ′ ) (K^{\prime},V^{\prime}) are the text and image-prompt keys and values, and λ b \lambda_{b} is the per-block image scale ( λ b = 0 \lambda_{b}{=}0 recovers the base model).
We lift the scalar λ b \lambda_{b} to a per-location map λ b ​ ( 𝐩 ) \lambda_{b}(\mathbf{p}) .
In our accelerator-friendly attention layout, the image-attention output is shaped [ B , C , 1 , H ​ W ] [B,C,1,HW] (one feature vector per latent position), so λ b ​ ( 𝐩 ) \lambda_{b}(\mathbf{p}) broadcasts over channels with no change to the attention computation itself.
This way, only the block’s scale input changes shape, and a uniform map again reproduces the scalar exactly.

blocks.en: 3.4. Resolution Semantics
blocks.zh: 3.4. 语义学决议

blocks.en:
The pixel-resolution maps are anti-alias downsampled to each modulation point.
Content modulation thus propagates multi-scale through the down-blocks—crisp where decisions are fine, soft where they are coarse—while style modulation is inherently coarser.
This asymmetry suits both factors: structure benefits from fine spatial control whereas the spatial assignment of style is a low-frequency, semantic choice.
blocks.zh:
像素分辨率地图是反异名下取样到每个调相点.
因此,内容调制通过下行区块传播出多尺度——在决定精细而柔软的地方——而风格调制则内在收缩。
这种不对称性既适合两个因素:结构得益于精细的空间控制,而风格的空间分配是一种低频率的语义选择.

blocks.en: 4. Results and Evaluation

blocks.en:

At its 1024 2 1024^{2} output resolution, the maps downsample to latent 128 2 128^{2} for ControlNet and 32 2 32^{2} / 64 2 64^{2} for the injected attention blocks.

blocks.en:
The two axes span a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 vocabulary (Fig. 1 ): content is locked or relaxed around a balanced default ( s = 0.5 s{=}0.5 ), while style starts at full strength ( λ b = 1.0 \lambda_{b}{=}1.0 ) and typically only relaxes .
Locking content preserves structure ( structure preserved ), relaxing style pulls the output toward the content image ( stylization weakened ), and both together can preserve a subject’s identity amid the stylized scene ( identity preserved ).
Relaxing either axis instead gives the text prompt more weight in the region, e.g., for content swaps (supplemental Fig. S1).
Because the Tile input is the content image, content-lock also displaces some stylization, which we can offset by co-raising λ b \lambda_{b} inside the region.

Depth sets the style weight (left), relaxing style frees the prompt’s “purple” (middle), and an object mask sharpens the glasses (right). Three demos, each with a source photo, a style image, and an automatically derived control mask above a uniform and a map-driven result: depth controlling watercolor strength over a tulip field, a subject mask freeing a water lily's purple color, and an object mask sharpening two glasses in a suprematist scene.

blocks.en:
Because the maps are continuous, sweeping the style scale and content strength over a fixed region moves it gradually from photographic to fully stylized (supplemental Fig. S2).
The maps can also be derived from per-pixel priors such as depth or segmentation (Fig. 4 ), echoing the gaze-directed abstraction of NPR ( DeCarlo and Santella, 2002 ) .
Neural style transfer supports spatial weighting as well ( Gatys et al., 2017 ) , but it can only restyle the given content, whereas our content pathway can also regenerate a region under the prompt.
Practitioner alternatives fall short: global scalars are not local, regional text prompts steer a different pathway, and stylize-then-composite merges two independently denoised results.
blocks.zh:
由于地图是连续的,将样式尺度和内容强度扫地到一个固定的区域,使其从相片逐渐向全层化移动(补充图. S2).
地图也可以从深度或分块等每像素前缀(图4)中取出,与目光定向抽象的NPR相呼应(DeCarlo and Santella, 2002.).
神经风格的转移也支持空间权重(Gatys等,2017年),但它只能重塑给定的内容,而我们的内容路径也可以再生出一个被快取的区域.
实践者替代品不足:全球标本不是本地的,区域文本提示引导不同的路径,而Stylize-when-composite合并了两个独立的去名结果。

blocks.en: 5. Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 限制

blocks.en:
Style localizes more coarsely than content because SDXL caps style modulation at 64 2 64^{2} latent resolution.
The 8 × 8\times pixel-to-latent downsampling leaves very small objects hard to control, and the 4 4 -step distilled sampler used in our experiments resolves intermediate strengths only coarsely.
Finally, relaxing style can reintroduce color into near-monochromatic styles (e.g., pen-and-ink), either from the source or through hallucination.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en:
We spatialize two conditioning weights of a ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization pipeline into per-location maps, yielding local, axis-specific control of content and style in a single coherent generation pass, with no retraining.
This brings region-by-region control of professional retouching to diffusion stylization: control maps pin a subject, relax a background, or adjust abstraction, while per-pixel priors author them automatically.
Future work includes additional ControlNet content types, crop-and-refine for small objects, learned mask priors, and spatial multi-style assignment.
blocks.zh:
我们将控制网+IP-Adapter分层化管道的两个条件权重空间化为每个位置的地图,在单一连贯的一代传入中产生局部,轴特定对内容和风格的控制,不进行再培训.
这带来了逐个区域对专业重修的控制权来进行扩散分层化:控制地图会给一个对象打针,放松背景,或调整抽象,而每个像素会自动给作者预发.
今后的工作包括额外的ControlNet内容类型,小物体的收割和收割,学习过的口罩前科,以及空间多风格的任务.
